thesis: GCT is in an intact uptrend (close 64.15 above SMA20 60.40, SMA50 56.67 and SMA200 45.08) and is holding its 11/5 earnings gap after a Q3 beat with revenue up 27% and net income up 36% YoY, at a forward P/E of 10.17 with low dilution risk. This is a pullback-only entry: the last close of 64.15 is above the zone, and R/R at that price is only about 1.2 (7.85/6.45), so the technical zone is narrowed to 62.0-63.0, where R/R is 1.70 to 2.33. The 11/16 rejection from the 67.40 high, the need for a breakout to reach 72.0, beta 1.6 and the risk-off regime (QQQ below its 50/200-day, VIX at the 0.877 percentile) keep this at Overweight with modest confidence, not Buy.
invalidation: A daily close below 57.7 (a full fill of the 11/5 earnings gap), or a close below the SMA20 (~60.4) on rising volume before entry.
key_risks: Risk-off regime with beta 1.6 and 11.5% of float short, so market drawdowns are amplified
